receipts.moved-to-obsidian: ledger row matches source path AND source sha256/dir-digest AND vault path AND vault sha256/dir-digest; vault side read-only (sha256sum). Relative vault paths resolve against SOUJI_VAULT (default /home/vgpnk/Documents/shokoknowledge).
receipts.ledger semantics: header skipped by prefix match; CR stripped from every row (CRLF ledgers parse); rows with <4 columns or empty hash columns are never a receipt; extra columns ignored; unterminated final row still parsed; duplicate rows: first fully-matching row wins.

cli_contract.mode: --cli opt-in; the CLI is advisory only — a CLI claim is never a receipt, the ledger row is
cli_contract.discovery: $SOUJI_CLI, else obsidian-cli on PATH, else ~/.local/bin/obsidian-cli, else ~/.local/bin/obsidian
cli_contract.gui_safety: a bare `obsidian` resolved from PATH is NEVER executed (this host: desktop launcher); any candidate whose first 2KB references app.asar/electron43/user-flags is refused unread -> cli=refused-launcher-shape. Verified by adv53 M8 (mock gui sentinel untouched) and selftest H2.
cli_contract.bound: timeout SOUJI_CLI_TIMEOUT (default 10s) per call; a hanging CLI degrades to cli=unparsed; the verdict still comes from local hashes
cli_contract.race_guard: the whole ledger probe is re-run after the CLI read, so a mutation or rename-swap under the CLI read can never yield a stale SAFE (adv53 O1/O2/O5/O6 PASS)
